name: approval_requests
description: Canonical current state of a human-owned Approval Request, from draft through a terminal decision or cancellation.
lifecycle: Created in DRAFT; retained through terminal state. No automatic deletion or legal retention duration is defined; production retention remains a separate decision.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated immutable UUID that is both the primary key and public resource identifier.
Immutable provider-independent Orion principal UUID of the human who owns the request; supplied by the trusted authentication boundary.
Owner-authored concise purpose of the approval request; editable only in DRAFT.
Optional owner-authored supporting context; editable only in DRAFT.
Current lifecycle state; APPROVED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED are terminal.
Optimistic concurrency token, initialized to one and incremented exactly once per successful edit or transition.
Reviewer-authored reason for rejection, present exactly when status is REJECTED.
columns.Null meaning: The request has not been rejected.

columns.Meaning: Opaque caller-supplied creation intent key, unique within creator_id and retained with the request.
SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical title and description creation intent; detects key reuse for different content.
PostgreSQL-clock absolute creation instant, serialized as UTC RFC 3339; does not constitute audit history.
PostgreSQL-clock absolute instant of the latest successful write; not a concurrency token or audit history.

constraints.Purpose: Optional description cannot be whitespace only.
Fingerprint is exactly lowercase SHA-256 hex.
Creation keys must use the documented opaque ASCII key alphabet and cannot be blank.
Enforces the immutable unique request identity used by persistence and the public API.
Requires one nonblank reason exactly for a rejected request.
Rejects blank titles even if a caller bypasses the API.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX approval_requests_creator_key_unique ON public.approval_requests USING btree (creator_id, idempotency_key)
constraints.Purpose: Prevents two requests for one owner and creation intent key, including racing inserts.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX approval_requests_mine_page_idx ON public.approval_requests USING btree (creator_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Supports authorized owner pagination by creation time and ID.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX approval_requests_review_page_idx ON public.approval_requests USING btree (status, created_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Supports submitted reviewable pagination before applying the non-owner predicate.
